name: 80,000 Hours
summary: Career research and advice for people who want to work on the world's most pressing problems, now mainly risks from advanced AI: a website, podcast and videos, one-on-one advising, headhunting and a job board. Run by Effective Ventures until 31 March 2025, now independent (80,000 Hours Limited, a non-profit company, and the 80,000 Hours Foundation, a UK charity).

spending.source: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/15746854/filing-history (80,000 Hours Limited, audited financial statements for 2025: administrative expenses £6,299,318, from 1 April when it took over from Effective Ventures; 80,000 Hours Foundation, charity 1212431, 2025: expenditure £53,959, less the £9,184 intellectual-property charge between them; at $1.3175 per pound, $8.36 million, plus January to March 2025 under Effective Ventures, about $2.6 million, a quarter of its $10.43M 2025 budget)
